notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be used to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
Cast Ribbons from your graveyard for its aftermath cost by paying {B}{B} and by paying all available {C}.
Resolve Riboons, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the colorless mana paid this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
